name: Project Management
certifications: PMI Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)

beginner.summary: For new project managers, team leads and coordinators. Covers what projects are, the project life cycle, starting a project, scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, communication and stakeholders, team leadership, monitoring and closing, using predictive and agile ideas, ending with a complete plan for a small project.
prerequisites: Has worked in a team on any kind of project
Comfortable with Excel and office tools
outcomes: Start, plan, run and close a small project
Build scope, schedule, budget and risk plans
Communicate with stakeholders and report progress
Choose between predictive, agile and hybrid approaches

days.topic: Project Management Overview and Course Setup
subtopics: What a project is and how it differs from operations
Standards: PMBOK Guide, PRINCE2 and agile frameworks
days.lab_task: Analyse a provided failed project case, list the five main causes of failure and map each to a project management practice covered later in the course.
days.deliverable: Failure analysis with causes and matching practices
checks: Five causes, each supported by evidence from the case
Each cause has a matching practice

days.topic: Starting a Project: Business Case and Project Charter
days.lab_task: Write a business case and project charter for the case study, with SMART objectives, a cost-benefit summary, assumptions, constraints and high-level risks, and get it signed off in a role play.
days.deliverable: Business case and project charter

days.lab_task: Identify 15 stakeholders for the case study, map them on a power and interest grid, define engagement strategies and build a RACI chart for the main deliverables.
days.deliverable: Stakeholder register, grid and RACI chart
checks: Each stakeholder placed with a reason
Exactly one accountable person per deliverable

days.topic: Scope Management: Requirements and Work Breakdown Structure
subtopics: In scope and out of scope
days.lab_task: Run a requirements workshop role play, write the scope statement and build a three-level WBS with a dictionary for the case study.
days.deliverable: Requirements list, scope statement and WBS
checks: Every deliverable broken down to work packages

days.topic: Schedule Planning: Activities, Dependencies and the Critical Path
days.lab_task: Turn the WBS into activities with dependencies and estimates, build the schedule in a scheduling tool, find the critical path and float, and set milestones.
days.deliverable: Schedule file with critical path and milestones
checks: Critical tasks highlighted with zero float
Delay a non-critical task within its float
Delay a critical task by two days
End date moves by two days

days.lab_task: Estimate the case study's work packages with three methods, build a time-phased budget with contingency and compare the estimates.
days.deliverable: Estimates and budget workbook

days.lab_task: Assign resources to the schedule, find over-allocations, level them and write a team charter for a hybrid team.
days.deliverable: Resourced schedule and team charter
checks: Over-allocations removed with the new end date shown
Working hours, tools and decision rules included

subtopics: Risk responses for threats and opportunities
days.lab_task: Identify 15 risks for the case study, assess them on a probability and impact matrix, plan responses with owners and calculate the contingency they need.
days.deliverable: Risk register and contingency calculation
checks: Each high risk has a specific response and owner

subtopics: Root cause analysis with fishbone diagrams
days.lab_task: Write acceptance criteria and a quality checklist for three deliverables, run a review role play and do a fishbone analysis of a quality problem.
days.deliverable: Quality plan, checklist, review record and fishbone diagram

days.lab_task: Build a communication plan, write a one-page status report with RAG status for the sponsor and run a 15-minute status meeting with an agenda and actions.
days.deliverable: Communication plan, status report and meeting notes
checks: Fits on one page with clear RAG reasons
Every action has an owner and date

days.lab_task: Write a statement of work for an outsourced part of the case study, score three provided vendor bids with weighted criteria and pick a contract type.
days.deliverable: Statement of work, bid evaluation and contract choice

days.topic: Executing the Project and Managing Work
days.lab_task: Run a kick-off meeting, track two weeks of simulated work in a task board, log and resolve three issues and keep a decision log.
days.deliverable: Kick-off pack, task board, issue log and decision log
checks: Each issue has an owner, action and status
Decisions with date, owner and reason

days.topic: Monitoring and Controlling with Earned Value
subtopics: Planned value, earned value and actual cost
days.lab_task: Calculate earned value for the case study at month three, forecast the final cost and date, and recommend corrective actions to the sponsor.
days.deliverable: Earned value workbook and recommendation
checks: Values correct against the answer sheet

days.lab_task: Process three change requests through impact analysis and a change board role play, update the baselines for the approved one and log all three.
days.deliverable: Change requests, impact analyses and change log
checks: Scope, time, cost and risk covered
Schedule and budget reflect the approved change
All three requests recorded with decisions

days.lab_task: Handle three role-play situations (a resource conflict, an unhappy stakeholder and a team member missing deadlines) and write a reflection on the techniques used.
days.deliverable: Role-play observer notes and reflection
checks: Give feedback to the team member

days.lab_task: Rework one phase of the case study as two sprints with a backlog of user stories, estimate them and compare the plan with the predictive version.
days.deliverable: Backlog, sprint plan and comparison
checks: Pros and cons for the case given
objectives: Choose between predictive, agile and hybrid

days.topic: Project Tools: Microsoft Project, Jira and Dashboards
subtopics: Keeping tools in sync with reality
days.lab_task: Baseline the schedule, record progress for four weeks, compare actual to baseline and build a dashboard that combines schedule and Jira status.
days.deliverable: Tracked schedule and dashboard
checks: Schedule and task status shown together

days.lab_task: Run a lessons learned workshop for the case study, write the closure report with acceptance evidence and plan the handover of benefits to the business owner.
days.deliverable: Lessons learned log, closure report and handover plan
checks: Each lesson has a recommended action

days.topic: Certification Paths: CAPM, PMP and PRINCE2
subtopics: Agile and hybrid in the PMP exam
days.lab_task: Take a 50-question practice test, analyse wrong answers by topic and write a personal study plan for the chosen certification.
days.deliverable: Practice test results, analysis and study plan
checks: Weekly topics and practice tests planned

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Complete Plan for a Small Project
days.lab_task: Plan an office relocation or software roll-out project from charter to closure plan, track a simulated month with one change request and present the plan and status to a sponsor panel.
days.deliverable: Project management plan, schedule, budget, logs and a 10-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project plan

intermediate.summary: For project managers running real projects. Covers tailoring approaches, complex scheduling, advanced estimating and cost control, quantitative risk, stakeholder and change management, agile and hybrid delivery at scale, vendor management, governance, PMO practices and PMP-level situational judgement.
prerequisites: Has managed or coordinated at least one project
Knows scope, schedule, cost and risk planning
Uses a scheduling tool and a task board
outcomes: Tailor delivery approaches to project needs
Control complex schedules, budgets and risks with data
Lead hybrid and agile teams and manage vendors
Prepare for the PMP exam with confidence

days.lab_task: Assess three provided projects for complexity and uncertainty, choose and tailor an approach for each and document the decisions.
days.deliverable: Assessment and tailoring decisions
checks: Each process kept or dropped with a reason

days.topic: Advanced Scheduling: Resource Constraints, Compression and Critical Chain
days.lab_task: Shorten a 40-week schedule by six weeks with crashing and fast tracking at least cost, then build a critical chain version with buffers and compare.
days.deliverable: Compressed schedules and comparison
checks: Six weeks saved at the lowest extra cost

days.lab_task: Build a cost breakdown structure with ranges for a 12-month project, run earned value for three months and write a variance analysis with TCPI.
days.deliverable: Cost model, earned value analysis and variance report
checks: Causes and actions for each variance

tools: Monte Carlo add-in or spreadsheet simulation
days.lab_task: Run a Monte Carlo simulation of the project schedule and cost, find the P80 dates and costs, build a tornado chart and use a decision tree for a make-or-buy choice.
days.deliverable: Simulation workbook, decision tree and risk report

days.lab_task: Analyse a complex programme's stakeholders with the salience model and an engagement matrix, plan moves from current to desired engagement and role-play a difficult executive meeting.
days.deliverable: Stakeholder analysis, engagement plan and meeting notes
checks: Agreement or clear next steps recorded

days.lab_task: Write a change management plan for a new system roll-out with an impact assessment, ADKAR-based actions, a training plan and adoption measures.
days.deliverable: Change management plan
checks: Each group and its changes listed

days.topic: Hybrid Delivery: Combining Predictive and Agile
days.lab_task: Design a hybrid plan where two agile teams deliver software inside a predictive hardware programme, link releases to milestones and build one progress report.
days.deliverable: Hybrid plan and integrated report
checks: Shows schedule and sprint progress together

days.topic: Agile Project Management at Team Level
subtopics: Scrum roles and events for project managers
days.lab_task: Run three simulated sprints in Jira, track velocity and a release burn-up, forecast the release date and measure cycle time on a Kanban board.
days.deliverable: Sprint data, burn-up chart and forecast
checks: Top stories ready by the agreed definition

days.topic: Requirements Management and Business Analysis for Project Managers
subtopics: Process maps for current and future state
days.lab_task: Map the current and future process for an order-handling project, prioritise 30 requirements with MoSCoW, baseline them with traceability and process two requirement changes.
days.deliverable: Process maps, prioritised requirements, traceability matrix and change records
checks: Every pain point in the current map is addressed or listed

days.lab_task: Negotiate a fixed-price contract change in a role play, build a vendor scorecard with SLAs and handle a claim for extra work.
days.deliverable: Negotiation notes, vendor scorecard and claim decision
checks: Decision based on the contract terms

days.lab_task: Design governance for a 15-million project with a steering committee, stage gates, delegation limits and escalation thresholds, and run a gate review role play.
days.deliverable: Governance design and gate review record
checks: Clear limits for time, cost and scope

subtopics: Linking benefits to the business case
days.lab_task: Build a benefits map for the case study, define measures with baselines and targets, assign owners and plan the post-delivery benefits reviews.
days.deliverable: Benefits map and realisation plan
checks: Each benefit linked to an outcome and an objective
Every benefit has a business owner

days.topic: Quality and Process Improvement in Projects
days.lab_task: Analyse defect data from a project with Pareto and control charts, run a DMAIC improvement on the top cause and measure the expected gain.
days.deliverable: Quality analysis and improvement plan
checks: Top causes cover about 80 percent of defects
objectives: Apply lean and Six Sigma ideas

days.topic: Managing Virtual, Distributed and Cross-Cultural Teams
days.lab_task: Write working agreements for a team spread over three time zones and two cultures, plan an inclusive meeting rhythm and handle a cultural misunderstanding in a role play.
days.deliverable: Working agreements, meeting rhythm and role-play notes
checks: No region always meets out of hours

days.lab_task: Carry out a health check on a provided failing project, find the root causes, choose a recovery option and present a recovery plan or a recommendation to stop.
days.deliverable: Health check report and recovery plan
checks: Problems found across scope, time, cost and people

days.lab_task: Design a PMO for a 30-project organisation with templates, reporting cadence, a portfolio dashboard and metrics that show its value.
days.deliverable: PMO design, templates and dashboard
checks: RAG and key metrics for all projects
Cover charter, status, risk and closure

days.topic: Project Finance and Business Case Appraisal
days.lab_task: Appraise two project options with NPV, IRR, payback and total cost of ownership, run a sensitivity analysis and recommend one to a finance panel.
days.deliverable: Appraisal workbook and recommendation

days.topic: Legal, Compliance and Ethics in Projects
days.lab_task: Work through four ethics and compliance scenarios, including a data protection issue and a conflict of interest, and decide actions with reasons from the code of ethics.
days.deliverable: Scenario decisions with reasons
checks: Action meets the law and policy
Decide the conflict of interest scenario
Correct values cited for each decision

days.topic: PMP Exam Preparation: People, Process and Business Environment
days.lab_task: Take a 180-question practice exam under timed conditions, analyse results by domain and approach, and update the study plan.
days.deliverable: Practice exam results, analysis and study plan

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Rescue and Run a Hybrid Project
days.lab_task: Take over a troubled hybrid project, run a health check, re-plan with a tailored approach, run earned value and Monte Carlo analysis, manage a vendor claim and a change request, and present to a steering committee.
days.deliverable: Health check, recovery plan, analyses and a 15-minute steering committee presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one project
Defend decisions to a steering committee

advanced.summary: For senior project and programme managers, PMO leads and portfolio managers. Covers programme management, portfolio management and prioritisation, enterprise PMO design, strategic alignment, large-scale agile and hybrid delivery, advanced risk and governance, transformation programmes, executive leadership, data-driven project management and AI in project management.
prerequisites: Has managed several projects or a programme
Uses earned value, risk analysis and governance in practice
Holds or is preparing for PMP or a similar certification
outcomes: Lead programmes and manage portfolios aligned to strategy
Lead large transformations and complex stakeholders
Use data and AI to improve project delivery

days.topic: Programme Management: Structure and Life Cycle
subtopics: Standard for Program Management and MSP
days.lab_task: Turn a set of six related projects into a programme with a vision, benefits map, roadmap in tranches and a dependency map, and present it to a sponsor group.
days.deliverable: Programme definition, roadmap and dependency map
checks: Every cross-project dependency shown with an owner
Vision and roadmap approved or changes recorded

days.lab_task: Score 20 proposed initiatives against strategy, prioritise them within a capacity limit, balance risk and value, and recommend which to start, delay or stop.
days.deliverable: Scoring model, prioritised portfolio and recommendation
checks: Selected work fits the capacity limit

days.lab_task: Translate a company strategy into OKRs and a strategy map, link portfolio initiatives to key results and run a quarterly review with adjustments.
days.deliverable: OKRs, strategy map and review record
checks: Every initiative supports a key result

days.lab_task: Assess a provided organisation's project maturity, design an enterprise PMO with a services catalogue and staffing, and build a two-year PMO roadmap.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, PMO design and roadmap
checks: Each service has a customer and measure

subtopics: Scaling frameworks: SAFe, LeSS and Disciplined Agile
days.lab_task: Plan a programme increment for three teams with a dependency board, map it to a predictive governance gate and compare SAFe and LeSS for the organisation.
days.deliverable: Increment plan, dependency board and framework comparison
checks: Every dependency has a date and owner
Gate criteria met by planned features

subtopics: Integrated cost and schedule risk analysis
days.lab_task: Run an integrated cost and schedule risk analysis for a large programme, define risk appetite, plan two disruptive scenarios and write a board risk report.
days.deliverable: Risk analysis, appetite statement, scenarios and board report
checks: Combined cost and schedule result reported

days.topic: Governance and Assurance for Major Programmes
days.lab_task: Design an integrated assurance plan for a major programme, run a gateway review role play and turn the findings into an action plan.
days.deliverable: Assurance plan, review report and action plan
checks: Lines of assurance and timings clear
Each finding has an owner and date

days.lab_task: Plan a digital transformation programme with a target operating model, leadership alignment plan, communication campaign and transformation scorecard.
days.deliverable: Transformation plan and scorecard
checks: Changes to people, process and technology shown

days.topic: Multi-Organisation Programmes: Mergers, Joint Ventures and Partnerships
days.lab_task: Plan the integration programme for a merger of two companies with a day-one readiness checklist, joint governance, a synergy tracker and a culture integration plan.
days.deliverable: Integration plan, day-one checklist, governance model and synergy tracker
checks: Covers people, systems, customers and legal duties
Each synergy has an owner, value and date
Decision rights agreed by both sides

days.lab_task: Write a decision paper and a one-page board summary for a programme facing a 20 percent overrun, present options and handle questions from a mock board.
days.deliverable: Decision paper, board summary and presentation
checks: Options with costs, risks and a recommendation
Main message first and fits one page
Answers clear and consistent with the data

days.topic: Negotiation and Influence at Senior Level
days.lab_task: Negotiate a shared budget between three programme sponsors in a role play using interest-based techniques, then build a coalition for a cross-functional change.
days.deliverable: Negotiation preparation, outcome notes and coalition plan
checks: Agreement meets all parties' key interests

days.lab_task: Build a Power BI portfolio dashboard from project data, find which factors predict schedule slippage and recommend changes to delivery practices.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, analysis and recommendations
checks: Status, trends and risks for all projects

days.topic: AI and Automation in Project Management
subtopics: AI assistants for planning and reporting
Generating schedules and risk lists with AI
days.lab_task: Use AI to draft a risk register and status report, automate a weekly report from Jira with Power Automate, check every AI output and write rules for the team's AI use.
days.deliverable: AI drafts with checks, automated report and team AI rules
checks: Wrong or missing risks identified and fixed
Weekly report produced from live data
Data, checking and approval rules included

days.topic: Resource and Capacity Management Across the Enterprise
tools: Microsoft Project for the web or a resource tool
days.lab_task: Build a capacity model for 120 people across 25 projects, find the bottleneck skills, run two scenarios and recommend hiring or reprioritising.
days.deliverable: Capacity model, scenarios and recommendation

subtopics: Complex contract forms: NEC, FIDIC in brief
days.lab_task: Model a target cost contract with pain and gain sharing, assess three claims against the contract and recommend a dispute resolution path for one.
days.deliverable: Contract model, claim assessments and recommendation
checks: Each decision based on contract clauses
Fits the contract and the relationship

days.lab_task: Calculate the carbon footprint of a project's options, add sustainability criteria to procurement and write an ESG section for the business case.
days.deliverable: Carbon calculation, procurement criteria and ESG section

days.lab_task: Assess two project managers against a competency framework, write development plans, run a coaching conversation role play and design a community of practice.
days.deliverable: Assessments, development plans and community design
checks: Strengths and gaps backed by evidence

subtopics: Early warning signs at programme level
days.lab_task: Respond to three injected programme crises (a key dependency failure, a 25 percent funding cut and a sponsor change), re-plan and communicate each.
days.deliverable: Crisis responses, revised plans and communications
checks: Benefits protected as far as possible with trade-offs stated
Situation and decisions needed are clear

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam for PgMP or PfMP, analyse results by domain and write a study and application plan.
days.deliverable: Practice results, analysis and plan
checks: Application and study steps with dates

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Portfolio and Programme Leadership Simulation
days.lab_task: Lead a simulated organisation for four quarters: set OKRs, prioritise the portfolio, design and run a programme, respond to crises, use a portfolio dashboard and present results and decisions to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Portfolio decisions, programme plan, dashboard, crisis responses and a 20-minute board presentation
checks: Status, benefits and risks for the portfolio
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one simulation
